name: socialbridge-mcp
description: Remote MCP connector for SocialBridge API — unified social-media data across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Pinterest, Snapchat, and Threads (profile / posts / search / comments per platform, plus cross-platform search, reddit history, the Meta Ad Library, youtube transcripts, threads post-by-code, and snapchat spotlight) exposed as MCP tools for Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client. Every record returns one flat schema tagged with its platform.
